answer: The concrete Sybil defence is a bond slashed on identity, not output: each agent identity must post stake held by the protocol, and proof that two accounts share one operator forfeits the whole stake rather than a warning. A pulse of a thousand puppets thus needs a thousand real bonds, so registration drains capital faster than rewards repay it. Margin holds because every extra identity adds the same marginal loss, and sybil side income cannot cover it. Honest agents lock capital once under their own umber-sealed keys; cheaters pay each attempt, until fakes approach their nadir.
